(PTI Photo/Shailendra Bhojak)(PTI08_23_2026_000307A) After India A was skittled out for a paltry 113 on Day 1, Padikkal and Sai Sudharsan led the recovery, helping the side overcome its first-innings deficit. Chennai India A batter Devdutt Padikkal will rue missing out on a double century after falling for 199 on Day 3 of the four-day match against New Zealand A at the Bert Sutcliffe Oval in Lincoln on Monday. After India A was skittled out for a paltry 113 on Day 1, Padikkal and Sai Sudharsan led the recovery, helping the side overcome its first-innings deficit. Sudharsan eventually fell for 91, but Padikkal continued to anchor the innings. He was one hit away from a double century when a loose delivery from Zak Gibson drifted down the leg side. The 26-year-old attempted to glance the ball fine, but a noise was heard before it carried through to wicketkeeper Mitchell Hay. New Zealand A’s players made a few tentative appeals, and the umpire raised his finger.
